metadata.title: mymun Conference Date Extract (Visa-Free Only)
metadata.effectiveFilters: All continents (`a=eu,as,sa,na,af,oc`), in-person only, future conferences, sort by price descending (`s=fe&r=desc`).
metadata.exportMethod: full filtered conference list API pull for review (11 pages at up to 50 rows per page, deduplicated by slug): `https://mymun.com/api/conferences?filter_time=future&sb=fe&order=desc&filter_cont=eu&filter_cont=as&filter_cont=sa&filter_cont=na&filter_cont=af&filter_cont=oc&online_conf=false&page={page}&per_page={perPage}`
metadata.note: The calendar view loads month-by-month and its calendar data request drops the sort params. This export pages through the full filtered conference list endpoint (the API caps each response at 50 rows, so multiple pages are fetched and deduplicated by conference slug) so all filtered conference date ranges are captured in one file. A source-side MUN relevance filter then keeps only entries whose slug, title, or name indicates a MUN or United Nations simulation.
filterRules: Kept only entries not marked as cancelled/canceled in the title.
Kept only destinations marked as visa-free for a Venezuelan passport.
No duration limit applied; all event lengths are included.
Preserved application status from the source; closed statuses are kept because some future events may reopen later.
